findings.why: AI-illustrated skin or hair frames suggest a change over time even with routine-stage labels and an AI mark; no study backs the frames.
findings.fix: Replace with real, consented study photos, or drop the frames before any use.

tone_read: Calm, ingredient-first before/after frames in Minimalist's voice with no fear, hype or emoji. The text is short and drawn from page usage or sourcing lines.
language_read: Hair Growth Actives 18% Hair Serum: the active and its strength are stated as on the page, with no unhedged efficacy verbs and no hair-growth or hair-fall wording beyond the product's own name. The creative carries an AI illustration mark and Severe risk, so it is review-only.
